{"reason": "All 8 failure rows are unneeded arbitrations; 6 have confidence <0.7 (0.44-0.67). Adding the (high-confidence? edi-change) gate removes low-confidence false arbitrations, cutting the 0.714 rate while high-confidence cases and recall are preserved (recall stays >=0.8), raising fitness.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
